article: Gambling Advertising and Problem Gambling in the United States: Multi-Level Evidence Beyond Sports-Betting Legal Status (Policy & Internet, POI370060, in production)
design: Vivvix quarterly state ad spend 2014-2023 x Google Trends index summed over 116 problem-gambling help-seeking queries; 41 states, 1,640 state-quarters.
